title: Small-Weight Quantum Operations on Lattice Conformal Nets
exact_target: Find conformal-net quantum operations with the stated quadratic composition law and weights arbitrarily close to one.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004281 (OWR-17292-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Subfactors and Applications (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2019/49, pp. 3053--3140. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 29, 30.
Bischoff, generalized orbifold construction for conformal nets (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Osborne et al., numerical evidence for a Haagerup CFT (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: Primary Problem 9 (PDF page 30, printed page 3082) asks for small positive real weights $w>1$. The catalogue adds arbitrarily small, which can be read as weights approaching $1$; that stronger quantifier was not verified in the primary source. The original small-weight construction question is preserved as source context, and the inherited stronger wording is explicitly not endorsed as a recovered theorem target. The nontriviality and actual weight convention exclude the vacuous identity operation.
